hooks.command: node -e "const input=JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync(0,'utf-8')||'{}'); const p=(input.tool_input&&input.tool_input.file_path)||''; const path=require('path'); const cfg=require(path.join(process.env.CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR||process.cwd(),'scripts/hooks/protected-paths.json')); const n=path.normalize(p).split(String.fromCharCode(92)).join('/'); const parts=n.split('/').filter(Boolean); const b=parts[parts.length-1]||''; const r=cfg.protectedBasenamePatterns.map(s=>new RegExp(s)); const segs=cfg.protectedPathSegments||[]; if(segs.some(s=>parts.includes(s))||r.some(x=>x.test(b))){ console.error('Blocked edit to protected path: '+p); process.exit(2);} process.exit(0);"

node -e "const input=JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync(0,'utf-8')||'{}'); const p=(input.tool_input&&input.tool_input.file_path)||''; const {spawnSync}=require('child_process'); const path=require('path'); if(!p) process.exit(0); const ext=path.extname(p); const map={'.ts':['npx','-y','prettier','--write',p],'.js':['npx','-y','prettier','--write',p],'.py':['black',p],'.go':['gofmt','-w',p],'.rs':['rustfmt',p]}; const cmd=map[ext]; if(!cmd) process.exit(0); const r=spawnSync(cmd[0],cmd.slice(1),{stdio:'inherit'}); process.exit(r.status ?? 1);"
